'''Agusti Pol''' (born 13 January 1977) is an [[Andorra]]n [[Association football|football]] player. He has played for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]]. He scored Andorra first goal ever (and his only international goal) in Andorra's first international match, a 6–1 defeat by [[Estonia national football team|Estonia]] on 13 November 1996.<ref>{{cite web|last=Duret |first=Sébastien |title=Andorra - List of International Matches |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesa/ando-intres.html |publisher=Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation|accessdate=13 November 2010 |date=26 April 2002 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20101018113928/http://www.rsssf.com/tablesa/ando-intres.html |archivedate=18 October 2010 |url-status=live}}</ref>
